meta.title: WoW Forever library books
meta.method_note: Fan-site pages could not be fetched directly from this environment (network allowlist); facts were gathered through web search summaries of the cited pages. Item IDs and per-book turn-in quest IDs come from the MIT-licensed RestedXP library-books route (github.com/heyitsmk/RXPGuides_LibraryBooks) and are cross-checked by web sources where noted (e.g. 79092/79093/79094). No GPL addon data was used. All notes are written in our own words. Re-checked live on 2026-11-26 (see verified).
meta.confidence_rule: high = 2+ sources agree on the point (differences under ~0.5 map % treated as rounding); single-source outliers are listed in alt without downgrading when a majority exists; low = no majority, unconfirmed spawn, or map-frame conflict.

book_count.note: 39 collectable books: 38 that every guide confirms plus A Luddite's Guide (Mage-only cage key, hand-in unconfirmed). Rumi has two spawns but is one book. The Liminal and the Arcane was removed (see removed).

how_tracking_works.summary: Each book is a soulbound item looted from a world object (no starter quest). While the item is in your bags, the turn-in NPC offers a quest named after the book; completing it consumes the book and records completion. Milestone quests (10/20/25/final) count distinct completed book quests. No dedicated book UI or slash command (/bookui) is mentioned by any source.
how_tracking_works.detect_carried: item count of the book item ID in bags
how_tracking_works.detect_turned_in: completed-quest flag of the per-book turn-in quest ID (IsQuestFlaggedCompleted)
how_tracking_works.per_book_reward: Each hand-in pays a Comprehension Charm (mage-usable); other classes still get credit toward milestones. Every book quest also leads to the Mage-only quest Research Access (97286).
gotchas: Several players found the book quests do not appear at the librarian when the quest log is near full (dropping under ~20 quests fixed it).
Librarians refused books until a Blizzard hotfix on 13 Nov 2026.
The 8 level-60 books (quest IDs 84395-84402) are handed to the mage trainers Jennea Cannon / Oran Snakewrithe, not the librarians.
Mages: keep the first book until Comprehend Scroll is trained at level 6, or the Study ability may go missing (SideQuest Dad).

removed.name: The Liminal and the Arcane
removed.reason: Not collectable in Forever: the quest exists in the 1.60.1 data but has no ender and the item has no source (Out of Games, Warcraft DB); in Season of Discovery it sat in Oneiros behind the Nightmare portal, which Forever lacks (ForeverChanges, wowcalc, wow4ever.quest).

verified.checked_live: Opened live: Out of Games WoW Forever database (quest, NPC, item pages, game data 1.60.1) for all 40 book quests, the 4 milestones and the 4 turn-in NPCs; Warcraft DB Forever (forever.warcraftdb.com) item/object pages for book object spawns (27 books have a recorded spawn pin with loots) and NPC pins; guide pages of Warcraft Tavern, ForeverChanges, wowcalc, wow4ever.quest, wowforevertools, mmonster, Method; RestedXP library-books route (MIT, v0.1.3).
verified.not_reachable: Wowhead Forever pages returned HTTP 403 (CloudFront block) from this environment, as did warcraft.wiki.gg (bot challenge), Icy Veins, Zockify, Conquest Capped and Overgear; their earlier claims are kept only where another source agrees.
verified.changed: Coordinates checked for every book: 20 entries changed. 18 of them by 0.1-0.5 map % to the game-data spawn or the guide majority (largest: Everyday Etiquette, Legends of the Tidesages, A Mind of Metal, Luddite's Guide); the 2 Blackrock Mountain books moved to the Burning Steppes map. Exact spawn pins are recorded as the first alt entry where the game data has one (27 books). 4 turn-in NPC ids filled and their positions corrected; faction locks reduced to 3 Horde books; Luddite's item/quest ids filled; The Liminal and the Arcane removed; milestone reward item ids added.
verified.uncertain: Faction locks are partly player-reported (Ta'zo, Ataeric) or unverified (Apothecary); the 84394 book count (30 vs 35); Luddite hand-in never confirmed by a player; The Knight and the Lady and Scourge may have extra spawn spots; 12 books have no game-data spawn pin, so they rely on guide consensus.
